text: commit 91d4afb656f321027c30a88e14b8680041ed59c1 Author: Martin Giger AuthorDate: Fri Feb 20 17:45:18 2026 +0000 Commit: Martin Giger CommitDate: Fri Feb 20 17:45:18 2026 +0000 Bug 2018204 - Add documentation about icons. r=vineet Sadly I couldn't really find receipts anymore, other than the commit history showing that this is the most recent style. I've also opted to omit explanations of the old systems (like that we used the 'new' folder so we didn't have conflicts with old icons that still exist) Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D284264 diff --git a/docs/index.rst b/docs/index.rst index 0a59d8ad5cf..62e4f72ad89 100644 --- a/docs/index.rst +++ b/docs/index.rst @@ -26,6 +26,7 @@ Thunderbird Source Tree Documentation /storybook/index /frontend/tabmail /frontend/trees + /frontend/icons .. toctree:: :caption: Mail Front End diff --git a/mail/base/docs/icons.md b/mail/base/docs/icons.md new file mode 100644 index 00000000000..85bf6e4d3ae --- /dev/null +++ b/mail/base/docs/icons.md @@ -0,0 +1,41 @@ +# Icons + +## Icon file structure + +Icons are placed into the appropriate folder for their size. They are then +registered at the very bottom in the `jar.inc.mn` of the `mail/themes/shared` folder and have a custom property of the +form `--icon-$name-$size` in `mail/themes/shared/mail/icons.css`. + +Icon size (px) | Folder | Custom property size suffix +---------------|-------------------------------------|---------------------------- +12x12 | `mail/themes/shared/mail/icons/xs/` | `xs` +16x16 | `mail/themes/shared/mail/icons/sm/` | `sm` +20x20 | `mail/themes/shared/mail/icons/md/` | `md` +24x24 | `mail/themes/shared/mail/icons/lg/` | `lg` + +Icons were previously placed just in the `icons` folder itself, and then later in the `new` subfolder. The goal is to eventually migrate and consolidate all icons to the new structure. There might still be exceptions for things like illustrations (which aren't really icons) or other higher resolution or color icons. + +## Using icons + +Icons are defined as custom properties in `chrome://messenger/skin/icons.css`. Whenever possible those definitions should be used to show an icon. + +We can do this even in `` elements by setting the `content` property: + +```css +img { + content: var(--icon-upload-sm); +} +``` + +We normally control the colors of the icons using `fill` and `stroke` from CSS. A few icons have hard-coded colors, either because they need more than two colors or because they are brand colors that should not change. Some icons also use the `fill-opacity` and `stroke-opacity` if set. + +```css +img { + content: var(--icon-upload-sm); + fill: grey; + stroke: currentColor; + -moz-context-properties: fill, stroke; +} +``` + +To see what all the various icons we have defined look like, check out the Design System → Icons story in [Storybook](storybook). diff --git a/mail/themes/shared/jar.inc.mn b/mail/themes/shared/jar.inc.mn index ae10bf036a8..8ced5e970aa 100644 --- a/mail/themes/shared/jar.inc.mn +++ b/mail/themes/shared/jar.inc.mn @@ -504,6 +504,7 @@ skin/classic/messenger/splitter.css (../shared/mail/splitter.css) skin/classic/messenger/widgets.css (../shared/mail/widgets.css) +# The "new" folder in the path of these icons is actually old now, too. skin/classic/messenger/icons/new/compact/account-settings.svg (../shared/mail/icons/new/compact/account-settings.svg) skin/classic/messenger/icons/new/compact/add.svg (../shared/mail/icons/new/compact/add.svg) skin/classic/messenger/icons/new/compact/add-circle.svg (../shared/mail/icons/new/compact/add-circle.svg) @@ -783,6 +784,7 @@ skin/classic/messenger/icons/new/activity/info.svg (../shared/mail/icons/new/activity/info.svg) skin/classic/messenger/icons/new/activity/error.svg (../shared/mail/icons/new/activity/error.svg) +# Icons should be registered below here, organized by icon size. # XS - 12x12px icons skin/classic/messenger/icons/xs/ascending.svg (../shared/mail/icons/xs/ascending.svg) skin/classic/messenger/icons/xs/close.svg (../shared/mail/icons/xs/close.svg)
